in_hebrew.name: מריה-יוֹסֵף
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from two Hebrew words: 'מריה' (Mar'yah) meaning 'rebellion' or 'rebellious' and 'יוֹסֵף' (Yosef) meaning 'God's gift'. This name is a combination of the two, expressing the idea of a woman who has rebelled but is still God's gift.

in_greek.name: Μαριάμ-Ιωσήφ
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek form of the Hebrew name 'מריה-יוֹסֵף' (Mar'yah-Yosef) is 'Μαριάμ-Ιωσήφ' (Mariam-Iosēph). 'Μαριάμ' (Mariam) is derived from 'מריה' (Mar'yah) and means 'rebellion' or 'rebellious'. 'Ιωσήφ' (Iosēph) is derived from 'יוֹסֵף' (Yosef) and means 'God's gift'. Together, the name means 'Rebelled-God'.

in_latin.name: Maria-Iosephus
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin form of the Greek name 'Μαριάμ-Ιωσήφ' (Mariam-Iosēph) is 'Maria-Iosephus'. 'Maria' is the Latin form of 'Μαριάμ' (Mariam) and means 'rebellion' or 'rebellious'. 'Iosephus' is the Latin form of 'Ιωσήφ' (Iosēph) and means 'God's gift'. Together, the name means 'Rebelled-God'.

in_english.name: Mary-Joseph
in_english.long_meaning: The English form of the name 'Maria-Iosephus' is 'Mary-Joseph'. 'Mary' is the English form of 'Maria' and means 'rebellion' or 'rebellious'. 'Joseph' is the English form of 'Iosephus' and means 'God's gift'. Together, the name means 'Rebelled-God's-gift'.
